g.text: a web front end that drives TANGO
drives TANGO through its command line
or its Python API, like any other client
data for TANGO, such as reservoir
command line: run · validate · init; writes the results (results_export)
optimization: NSGA-II over full runs, surrogates on sampled runs
Workflow: reads the config, builds the components, runs them
SystemDirect: one pass per timestep · SystemBCIteration: the solver loop
registry.py maps (type, variant) to a class
the surface plant, a TESPy network
Component, Stream, LockedState, config schemas, errors, fluid properties, solvers
Libraries used in-process: TESPy solves the
reached through a connector: TANGO's adapter class, registered as a variant
